security: Exact media-origin validation, URL credentials/port/fragment rejection, server-side token authentication, textContent rendering and empty connectDomains are good. Provider/click redirect following permits server network requests outside configured origin; early failed responses are not always aborted/cancelled.
complexity: Appropriately bounded scope and no added framework. Prefer targeted network policy and tests over retry cascades or broadened origin policies.

findings.impact: Both fetch calls omit redirect policy, so built-in fetch follows redirects (including a different origin or HTTP destination). A configured HTTPS API origin is not an enforced network boundary, contrary to the approved single-origin path. Discovery can consume redirected data and click reporting can contact another destination.
findings.recommendation: Reject redirects with redirect: error (or explicitly bounded same-origin HTTPS handling), and test discovery and click redirect rejection. Preserve distinct provider_unavailable/best-effort failure outcomes.

findings.impact: HTTP-error and oversized Content-Length branches throw without cancelling the response body or aborting the controller, then clear the deadline timer. A provider can leave an unconsumed response downloading or holding a connection beyond the advertised request bound.
findings.recommendation: Ensure abort/cancel cleanup on all early exits and after successful completion as appropriate. Add response-body cancellation and slow/timeout tests, including declared oversize and HTTP failure.

findings.impact: Approved TECH explicitly requires executing the delivered registered script bridge/selection behavior. Current tests only parse it and exercise renderer/controller separately, so broken ontoolresult wiring or click-tool integration can pass. Timeout behavior, app-only metadata, and several stated stale-event/report dedup cases are also not asserted.
findings.recommendation: Execute the actual delivered inline bundle in a controlled DOM/host bridge fixture; deliver a country result, select A/B, operate Play/Pause, verify matching source/token and no autoplay, and assert failed new results clear prior state. Add focused timeout, app-only visibility, dedup/resume and stale-event checks.

findings.impact: radio-v2 remains the same URI while its inline bundle/controller materially changes. This violates approved version-on-script-change policy and allows cached hosts to use old behavior under the advertised unchanged resource identity.
findings.recommendation: Either preserve the exact prior radio-v2 delivered resource or version the baseline resource and update references/documentation while keeping open_radio behavior.

findings.location: src/discovery.ts:86; README.md runtime instructions; implement-output.json blockers
findings.impact: The broad claim that this runtime requires another host with Node HTTPS egress is contradicted by the successful bounded IPv4 Node probe. Existing default-family behavior leaves the core live tool unavailable despite a reachable provider.
findings.recommendation: Investigate the minimal supported family-selection configuration/startup option, document it and verify full bounded FR/GB calls and Inspector outcomes. Do not substitute the probe for catalog or audible host evidence, and do not add retries or a proxy.

findings.impact: UUID acceptance is case-insensitive, but token parsing accepts lowercase only. An uppercase provider UUID yields a displayed selectable row whose freshly generated clickToken always fails verification.
findings.recommendation: Normalize accepted UUIDs to lowercase before signing/returning, or accept uppercase consistently; add an uppercase UUID token test.
